intro.text: A domed, Soulcast building on the Shattered Plains, part of the king's complex and home to the Prime Map.

description.text: It stands east of Elhokar's palace. Big skylights in the dome light shalebark growths inside, and its size and smooth finish made it costly to Soulcast. Besides many maps, it keeps a parchment tallying the gemhearts each highprince has won under the Vengeance Pact.
Urithiru has its own Gallery of Maps, a quiet, windowless room on the tower's second-highest floor named in honour of this one.

items.text: Dalinar met Highprince Roion there to try to win him over to a joint assault.
Before the expedition into the heart of the Plains, Shallan came to study the Prime Map.
In the Urithiru room of the same name, Dalinar met Taravangian, Queen Fen, several Alethi leaders and the Azish generals, each with a delegation.
